betrayal_loyalty.name: Betrayal & Loyalty
betrayal_loyalty.formula: Character discovers they're second-best → emotional moment → resolution
hook_templates: He thought he was the only one...
She waited every day. Until yesterday.
Three years of loyalty. Gone in one moment.
He didn't see it coming...

unexpected_kindness.name: Unexpected Kindness
unexpected_kindness.formula: Hard exterior → vulnerable moment → someone sees them
hook_templates: They said he had no heart. They were wrong.
Nobody expected her to care.
The one everyone avoided... did something unexpected.
Sometimes the coldest hearts hide the warmest souls.

secrets_revealed.name: Secrets Revealed
hook_templates: She knows everything. And she's about to tell.
The secret he kept for three years...
Nobody knew what he did every Tuesday.
Some secrets are meant to be found.

jealousy_insecurity.name: Jealousy & Insecurity
jealousy_insecurity.formula: New arrival → existing character reacts → realization
hook_templates: She used to be the baby. Then the kitten came home.
He was the favorite. Was.
There's only room for one... right?
Being replaced hurts more than being forgotten.
themes: younger animal can do things they can't

found_family.name: Found Family
hook_templates: Everyone gave up on him. Then he found where he belonged.
She never had a family. Until now.
Sometimes family isn't who you're born with.
He finally found his pack.
